attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This is a large, breaking change to the GraphQL API surface: it changes the IIndexAliasProvider interface signature (GetAliases -> GetAliasesAsync), alters IContentDefinitionEventHandler with new required methods, changes field naming behavior (fieldName.ToCamelCase() instead of raw fieldName) which can rename existing GraphQL fields and break client queries, and substantially restructures DynamicContentTypeBuilder/WhereInputObjectGraphType logic used across many modules (Alias, Autoroute, ContentLocalization, Lists) — any downstream module implementing these interfaces or relying on prior field names/behavior will fail to compile or behave differently."}
